title: Reconciling the neurogenic hypothesis of depression with recent advances in adult hippocampal neurogenesis research in humans
title_zh: 重新审视人类成年海马神经发生研究中的抑郁症神经发生假说与最新进展
abstract: Depression is a highly prevalent mood disorder with a complex etiology that has yet to be fully characterized. Alterations in the generation of new granule neurons in the hippocampal dentate gyrus have been hypothesized to contribute to the pathophysiology of depression and recovery from this mood disorder, a theory coined the “neurogenic hypothesis of depression”. This article revisits current evidence of this hypothesis in humans, which reveals varying perspectives from post-mortem studies. Drawing on recent findings in the field of human adult hippocampal neurogenesis, we also offer here potential research directions regarding how immature granule neurons, which have been so far understudied in this context, may be affected in the pathogenesis of depression. Finally, this review explores to what extent immature granule neurons are involved in the neurobiological basis of this mood disorder and how their properties may increase their vulnerability to stress-mediated changes in the hippocampus. Together, this review provides crucial insight into immature granule neurons as a particularly interesting therapeutic target to mitigate stress-related behavioural impairments.
abstract_zh: 抑郁症是一种高发的情绪障碍，其病因复杂，尚未完全阐明。海马齿状回新生 granule 细胞的产生异常已被假设为抑郁症病理生理学及从该情绪障碍中恢复的关键因素，这一理论被称为“抑郁症神经发生假说”。本文综述了该假说在人类中的现有证据，揭示了尸检研究中的不同观点。结合人类成年海马神经发生领域的最新发现，我们还提出了关于未被充分研究的不成熟 granule 细胞可能如何在抑郁症病理机制中受到影响的潜在研究方向。最后，本综述探讨了不成熟 granule 细胞在该情绪障碍神经生物学基础中的程度，以及它们的特性如何使其易受压力介导的海马变化的影响。综上，本综述为将不成熟 granule 细胞作为缓解压力相关行为障碍的 particularly interesting 治疗靶点提供了关键见解。
